requirements.title: Recording a verdict on a version
requirements.rationale: A developer or a review agent must be able to say approve or reject about one exact version of a change, once per user, so that policy has evidence to count (LAND-FR-050, LAND-FR-051, LAND-FR-053).

criteria.condition: a user with read access to the workspace sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/changes/:number/approvals with an API key or with a PAT that holds changes:approve, a valid body {verdict, version?, comment?}, the change is draft or open, and that user has no verdict on the named version
criteria.action: store the verdict on the version the body names, or on the current version when it names none, and return the approval
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with an approval {id (a UUID), change, version, verdict, comment ('' when the body gave none), by {actor_type: api_key or pat, actor_id: the caller's user id, username}, counts_for (an array), carried_from: null, created_at}; the store holds exactly one verdict of that user on that version

criteria.condition: a user who already has a verdict on the named version of a draft or open change sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/changes/:number/approvals with a valid body, with the same or another of that user's credentials
criteria.action: replace the earlier verdict with the new one, so that the user still has exactly one verdict on that version
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the new approval: a new id, a new created_at, carried_from null and the body's verdict and comment; the earlier id names no verdict afterwards; the list of the change's verdicts holds one entry for that user and version

requirements.title: Listing and withdrawing verdicts
requirements.rationale: Readers need the evidence on a change, and the author of a verdict, the workspace owner and the operator need a way to take one back (§8.5).

criteria.condition: a caller with read access to the workspace and, for a PAT, the scope changes:read sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/changes/:number/approvals, with or without the query parameter version

criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with {items, next_cursor}: items are approval objects ordered by created_at descending and then id descending, limited to the named version when version is given; items is [] when there are none; limit and cursor page through the same order

requirements.title: The counting rule

execution_paths.title: A check report and an owner's approval make a change ready

steps.action: has set a policy on the workspace that requires one approval by the owner and the check test
opens a change from its fork with the token bound to that fork; the change is pending
runs parley change check <slug> 1 test --status passed with a PAT of the owner that holds only checks:write
stores the result, writes parley.change.check and re-evaluates the change, which stays pending because no approval counts yet
sends POST …/changes/1/approvals with the token that pushed the change and is refused 403 token_bound
runs parley change approve <slug> 1 with an API key
stores the verdict, finds that it counts toward the requirement, writes parley.change.approve and re-evaluates the change to ready
runs parley change approvals <slug> 1 and parley change checks <slug> 1 and sees the verdict with its counts_for and the passed check

setup: a hub started in-process on 127.0.0.1:0 with a store and repositories in a temporary directory and a recording event writer in place of the event log of package 52

user alice with an API key owns workspace w1, whose repository the test seeds with git init and one commit; alice has a PAT ci with only checks:write; fork f1 of w1 with a token bound to it holds one more commit on a branch

alice has set the policy {default: {approvals: 1, approvers: ['owner'], checks: ['test']}} through PUT /api/v1/workspaces/w1/policy, and change 1 was opened from f1 with the bound token through POST /api/v1/workspaces/w1/changes
end_state: GET /api/v1/workspaces/w1/changes/1 shows landing.status ready, with the requirement's approvals.counted 1 and its check test passed
parley change approvals w1 1 prints one item by alice with counts_for ['default']; parley change checks w1 1 prints one item named test with status passed
the event writer holds one parley.change.check and one parley.change.approve event for change 1, in that order
the bound token's POST of a verdict was answered 403 token_bound and stored nothing

execution_paths.title: Evidence survives a pure rebase and is dropped by a content change

steps.action: pushes version 1 of a change with a PAT and approves it with the same PAT
records the verdict and does not count it, because the credential created the version; the change stays pending
approves version 1 with an API key, and a check runner's report of test passed is on version 1
counts the developer's approval and re-evaluates the change to ready
rebases the source branch onto the moved target without changing its content
records version 2 as patch-equivalent to version 1, copies both verdicts to it with carried_from 1, applies the check result of version 1 to it, and keeps the change ready
commits a content change to the source branch
records version 3 with no verdicts and no applying check result and re-evaluates the change to pending
